map.headingUpA11y: Location mode: course heading up; tap for free orientation
map.freeHeadingA11y: Location mode: free orientation; tap for north up
map.northUpA11y: Location mode: north up; tap for course heading up

settings.title: Settings
settings.rideDashboardHint: Timer, sport, location and dashboard fields
settings.supplyRemindersHint: Fuel, hydration, notifications, voice and vibration
settings.autoLapHint: Create laps by distance without displaying a manual Lap control
settings.presetSportHint: Choose the sport for your next ride; you can still change it from the dashboard
settings.autoPauseDescription: Cycling pauses automatically after about 10 seconds without credible GPS movement. It resumes with reliable speed and displacement; running uses motion sensing, while hiking keeps a stop prompt. These rules are applied automatically.

settingsDetail.birthdaySetHint: Age {{age}}; the app updates it after your birthday.
settingsDetail.birthdayUnsetHint: Set once to estimate age and heart-rate baselines.
settingsDetail.bikeWeightHint: Set 3–35 kg; used for live power, calories, background tracking, and route estimates.
settingsDetail.autoMetricsIntro: Training and body metrics below are estimated locally from rides; you do not need to enter each value.
settingsDetail.autoMetrics: FTP {{ftp}} W · Max heart rate {{maxHeartRate}} bpm · Resting heart rate {{restingHeartRate}} bpm
settingsDetail.rpeHint: RPE is estimated after each ride from intensity, duration, climbing, and conditions.
settingsDetail.metricsFallback: Not enough power history yet; using a conservative baseline while calibration continues.
settingsDetail.backgroundGpsHint: Changing this restarts background location while riding. Higher accuracy uses more battery but improves tracks; auto-pause and low-battery protection may temporarily reduce it.
settingsDetail.supplyEnabledHint: Smart, manual, and custom rules can schedule fuel and hydration reminders.
settingsDetail.supplyDisabledHint: All fuel and hydration reminders are off. Countdowns, dialogs, notifications, speech, sound, vibration, and repeats are paused until enabled.
settingsDetail.smartBothHint: Fuel and hydration use smart countdowns. The next interval is recalculated from FTP, weight, intensity, duration, grade, and conditions. Each fuel serving currently contains {{serving}} g of carbohydrate.
settingsDetail.smartEnergyHint: Fuel uses a smart countdown. Each serving currently contains {{serving}} g of carbohydrate; hydration can use a manual time or distance rule below.
settingsDetail.smartWaterHint: Hydration uses a smart countdown; fuel can use a manual time or distance rule below.
settingsDetail.smartOffHint: Smart fuel and hydration are off; choose separate manual time or distance rules below.
settingsDetail.servingCarbohydrateHint: Set 10–100 g. Smart fuel countdowns and route carrying estimates use this serving size.
settingsDetail.scienceCarbohydrateHint: Derived from {{weight}} kg: {{rate}} g/h (about {{perKg}} g/kg/h; maximum 90 g/h). Turn off the switch above to set it manually.
settingsDetail.manualCarbohydrateHint: Set 20–90 g/h. This limit and serving size calculate the smart fuel countdown.
settingsDetail.applyHourlyLimitA11y: Calculate from body weight and apply a {{rate}} g/h carbohydrate limit
settingsDetail.smartRuleNotice: Smart categories remind when their next countdown ends. Other categories may use fixed time or distance rules below; the two approaches do not duplicate notifications.
settingsDetail.energyRuleHint: Fuel can be reminded by time or distance.
settingsDetail.waterRuleHint: Hydration can be reminded by time or distance.
settingsDetail.repeatHint: Repeat every {{seconds}} seconds while the dialog is unconfirmed.
settingsDetail.displayAppearanceHint: Theme, screen awake, battery saving, and dashboard layout
settingsDetail.appearanceThemeHint: Choose light, dark, or follow your phone system theme.
settingsDetail.dimAfterIdleHint: Touch, a turn prompt, or a fuel reminder restores brightness immediately.
settingsDetail.idlePowerMonitoring: Switch to low-power monitoring after stopping
settingsDetail.idlePowerMonitoringHint: Full location resumes automatically when movement is detected.
settingsDetail.unlockHoldHint: Default: 400 ms. Choose a familiar unlock duration.
settingsDetail.autoRelockHint: After touch lock is released while riding, it locks again after this duration.
settingsDetail.simplifiedIdleHint: Enter simplified mode after being idle for this duration while riding.
settingsDetail.idleRecenterHint: After panning or rotating the map with two fingers, wait this duration before recentering. It is stored locally and preserves the current heading-up, free, or north-up mode.
settingsDetail.dragDashboardFields: Drag the three-line handle on the right to change order. The first {{count}} fields show in the compact panel.
settingsDetail.dragCompactFields: Drag the three-line handle on the right to change order. Enable at most {{count}} fields.

routes.weatherUnavailable: Weather unavailable; using 25°C for the estimate
routes.carryFactors: Estimated from {{factors}}; the maximum includes a high-load or delay reserve.
routes.offlinePlanningNote: Excludes rests, intersections, traffic, actual wind, and road conditions; for offline planning only.

summaryDetail.routeNameHint: View, edit, and share this activity from History after saving.
summaryDetail.mediaLocal: Photos and videos stay on this device.
summaryDetail.addMediaEmpty: Add photos or videos to this ride
summaryDetail.powerNote: {{source}}; calories are estimated locally and are not power-meter or metabolic measurements.
summaryDetail.lapsHint: Lists distance-based laps created automatically during this activity. Saved laps match activity details and FIT export.
summaryDetail.mediaWaitBody: The ride record is still being prepared. Add media again shortly.
summaryDetail.mediaErrorBody: Allow photo or video selection, then try again.
